# ==============================================================================
# 0. Embedded deps (AHK2 zip Base64; 快捷键4.ahk Base64 — offline bootstrap)
# ==============================================================================
$ahk2_bin_zip_A11111 = ''

# 快捷键4.ahk (filled by 快捷键4.ahk on startup when init.txt exists)
$ahk_kjj4_script_A22222 = ''

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Find install drive (prefer non-C fixed disk)
# ==============================================================================
$targetDrive = Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk |
    Where-Object { $_.DriveType -eq 3 -and $_.DeviceID -ne 'C:' } |
    Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty DeviceID

if (-not $targetDrive) {
    $targetDrive = "C:"
}
Write-Host "1. Target drive" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "   -> $targetDrive" -ForegroundColor White


# ==============================================================================
# 2. Create directories
# ==============================================================================
Write-Host "2. Create directories" -ForegroundColor Cyan

$baseDir    = Join-Path $targetDrive "helpme"
$ahkDir     = Join-Path $baseDir "ahk"
$installDir = Join-Path $ahkDir "ahk_install2"

if (-not (Test-Path $baseDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $baseDir -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "   -> created: $baseDir" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "   -> exists: $baseDir" -ForegroundColor Gray
}

if (-not (Test-Path $installDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $installDir -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "   -> created: $installDir" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "   -> exists: $installDir" -ForegroundColor Gray
}


# ==============================================================================
# 3. Unpack AHK2 zip from Base64
# ==============================================================================
Write-Host "3. Unpack AHK2" -ForegroundColor Cyan

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ahk2_bin_zip_A11111) -or $ahk2_bin_zip_A11111.StartsWith('PLACEHOLDER')) {
    Write-Warning "   -> ahk2_bin_zip_A11111 empty, skip"
} else {
    try {
        $zipPath = Join-Path $installDir "ahk2_temp.zip"
        Write-Host "   -> decoding Base64..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $zipBytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($ahk2_bin_zip_A11111.Trim())
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($zipPath, $zipBytes)
        Write-Host "   -> expanding to: $installDir" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Expand-Archive -Path $zipPath -DestinationPath $installDir -Force
        Remove-Item -Path $zipPath -Force
        Write-Host "   -> AHK2 ready" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Error "   -> AHK2 unpack failed: $_"
    }
}


# ==============================================================================
# ==============================================================================
# 4. Write 快捷键4.ahk from embedded Base64 (no network)
# ==============================================================================
Write-Host "4. Write AHK script from Base64" -ForegroundColor Cyan

try {
    $scriptPath = Join-Path $baseDir "快捷键4.ahk"
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ahk_kjj4_script_A22222) -or $ahk_kjj4_script_A22222.StartsWith('PLACEHOLDER')) {
        Write-Warning "   -> ahk_kjj4_script_A22222 empty/PLACEHOLDER, skip (run 快捷键4.ahk once beside init.txt to fill)"
    } else {
        Write-Host "   -> decoding Base64..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $scriptBytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($ahk_kjj4_script_A22222.Trim())
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($scriptPath, $scriptBytes)
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scriptPath) -or ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $scriptPath).Length -lt 100)) {
            throw "decoded script empty or too small"
        }
        Write-Host "   -> saved: $scriptPath" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
} catch {
    Write-Error "   -> write AHK script failed: $_"
}

Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Init done" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
